first_shown: Gen 6 May 2023; Gen 7 April 2024; Gen 8 (wheeled) December 2024
target_applications: automotive manufacturing pilots, retail/logistics, teleop data capture for AI training

base_type.value: wheeled (small mobile base; legs dropped as 'too frail to support a strong torso')

actuators.value: hydraulic hands/wrists via proprietary miniaturized hydraulic valves; electric elsewhere (details n/a)

end_effector.value: two 21-DoF hydraulic dexterous hands, four fingers + opposable thumb, in-hand manipulation capable

sensors_head.value: upgraded depth + RGB cameras (wider FoV, higher resolution), improved audio/video for teleop (Gen 8)

sensors_wrist_hand.value: fingertip tactile sensors, ~5 mN force detection threshold; new touch sensors added Feb 2025

software_stack.value: Carbon AI control system; teleoperation-first data capture; NVIDIA Isaac Lab sim-to-real RL for hands; Microsoft AI collaboration; closed platform, no public SDK

safety_compliance.value: vendor states measures 'exceed specified safety standards'; no specific certifications published

availability.value: partner pilots only (Magna and other strategic partners); no open orders

deployment_evidence.value: Gen 5 retail pilot Jan 2023; Magna plant trials 2024-2025 (material handling, sub-assembly, <24h task learning); June 2026 wire-plugging production task with Tier 1 automotive supplier

notes: Generation numbering: Sanctuary's Dec 2024 release is called 'Gen 8' by press/analysts; vendor materials say 'new generation' and image files are labeled gen_7. 2026: company pivoting to selling Physical AI software for industrial robots; Phoenix hardware de-emphasized.
